usage: Used as a general countable noun for jewellery in everyday Hong Kong Cantonese. It can refer to one piece or a whole set, depending on context.
Common with verbs like 買、戴、送、收藏. It often appears in shopping, gift-giving, and fashion contexts.
Can refer to both precious items and decorative accessories, so the exact meaning depends on the situation.
Neutral and very common. For specific items, people often use more precise words such as 項鍊, 戒指, 耳環, 手鐲.
